target_customer: Staffing and recruitment agencies using ATS platforms such as Bullhorn
problem: Agencies hold large candidate databases they cannot search or present well, and recruiters lose time formatting resumes and emailing clients.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for recruiting teams
product_category: AI layer and workspace for recruitment agencies

founders.name: Jan Alexander Jedlinski
founders.background_notes: YC bio says he has built products for the staffing industry since 2016. Interview says he started in Austria and moved to the US with YC in 2017.

founders.name: Benjamin Bartakovics
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on the YC page.

founders.name: Daniel Bartakovics
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Early product was resume and storefront software; later AI search and ATS integration over APIs added difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: ATS integrations and white label client portals add stickiness, but the ATS vendors control the data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Bullhorn became a partner and strategic investor in 2022 rather than a copier.

market_need_then: Agencies rely on large ATS databases; the company claims faster shortlists and time saved per resume, which are its own claims.

branding.domain_note: Uses candidately.com; an alternate candidate.ly domain also appears.

rebrands.why: Not stated; Speedinvest lists the company as Gustav and the YC listing for Gustav exists.

brand_strength.rationale: Easily confused with Candidly, Candidate.fyi and similar names, and little brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Candidately started as Gustav in Austria, joined YC in 2017, and moved toward an AI layer for recruitment agencies sitting on Bullhorn and other ATS tools. It took a strategic investment from Bullhorn Ventures in 2022 and stayed small, with traction unclear.
notes: Seedtable lists a seed of about 980K in August 2017 with Speedinvest and Y Combinator; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round. The Bullhorn Ventures round is described by Seedtable as strategic with no amount; its label other is used because no stage is stated. Some directories claim a 2021 founding, which conflicts with YC (2017). Competitors empty: no source dated near 2017 found. Founder education not found. The Gustav relationship comes from the YC bio and Speedinvest listing via a search summary.
